title: Microvascular Permeability and Lipoprotein Flux Protocol
author: John Rutledge
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.56vg9e6

steps.title: Anesthetize Mice
steps.instruction: Anesthetize mice via intraperitoneal injection of pentobarbital at a dose of 50 mg/kg weight.

steps.title: Administer Fluorescently Labeled Compounds
steps.instruction: Administer 100 µL of the selected fluorescently labeled compound (FLC) via bolus injection into the left femoral vein. Alternatively, infuse 100 µL of the FLC alone (40 mg/mL).

substeps.instruction: Option A: FITC-albumin (40 mg/mL) in PBS
Option B: FITC-albumin (40 mg/mL) in VLDL (150 mg/dL)
Option C: FITC-albumin (40 mg/mL) in VLDL (150 mg/dL) + LpL (2 U/mL)
Option D: LpL (2 U/mL) in PBS

steps.title: Clear Vasculature and Fix Heart
steps.instruction: Remove excess FLC from the vasculature and initiate fixation via the left ventricle of the heart.

substeps.instruction: Infuse DMEM media into the left ventricle for 20 min to remove excess FLC
Infuse 10% formaldehyde into the left ventricle for 20 min

steps.title: Harvest and Fix Tissues
steps.instruction: Immediately remove microvascular-rich tissues and fix them in 10% formaldehyde for two days.

substeps.instruction: Collect microvascular tissues (e.g., brain, heart, and mesentery)
Collect macrovascular tissues (e.g., common carotid arteries or aorta)

steps.title: Prepare Tissue Sections
steps.instruction: Embed the fixed tissues in paraffin and section them to a thickness of 5 µm.

steps.title: Image Tissue Sections
steps.instruction: Deparaffinize and rehydrate the tissue sections, then image them using fluorescent microscopy.
